reviews.t: Soft N Style 60 piece rubber rod set
reviews.x: I like this set because it's fun, easy, and fast! I love it! And it's enough for my hair as well!

I purchased these rods right before christmas and I was so excited once I got them.  I rodded my hair, wrapped my hair in a scarf and slept on the rollers with no problem.  When I woke up I had some wonderful curls.  My curls lasted for over three days and the only reason im sure they didn't last longer is because I had to wash them out.  I didn't have to use a bunch of hair spray or any other products for that matter and I ended up with soft, bouncy curls.  LOOVVVEEEE IIIIITTTTT.

The reason why I gave it 2 stars is because these things smell to high heaven. They smelt like an old peoples home. I tried washing them to get rid of the smell, but the smell won't go away and the smell gets in my hair. It's unbearable and I'm very angry about how awful it smells. Not to mention, the bag the flexi rods came in had 2 tares in it. Other than that the rods work perfectly and leave very nice curls.

I Youtubed tutorials before buying this and was skeptical because of my hair type (thick and blonde). However, I found a way to make them work as intended. Instead of bending them, I use small clips on the end of my hair to keep my hair from unraveling. I sleep on them although they are not the most comfortable. I recommend to anyone trying to go heatless like myself! :)

claims.text: Most reviewers say the rods bend and work as expected, with several noting they tested all the rods upon arrival.
A minority report that the grey and purple rods do not bend at all, making them unusable.
Reviewers frequently praise the value and price, calling it a great buy for the money.
Several reviewers say the set works well on natural hair and weaves and is easy to use.
Some reviewers mention being able to sleep in the rods and getting long-lasting curls.
